verdict.rationale: Cloudflare's pricing copy mentions 'hibernating WebSockets' billed only for compute, not wall time. The Agents SDK, built on Durable Objects, claims 'built-in support for real-time communication' with per-user, per-session or per-game-room instances that hibernate and wake on demand. Together these imply persistent connections are supported, but only through glancing marketing mentions rather than dedicated docs; a 2022 community comment noting WebSockets were then in beta is dated and not a concrete failure. Missing for 10: dedicated WebSocket API documentation for Workers/Durable Objects, explicit connection lifecycle and limits details, current GA status, and independent hands-on corroboration.
